The '''LG-5''' was a set of matching [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], one of which had a small, powerful [[Laser/Legends|laser]] in it. Users could get a second laser in the other gauntlet for double the price. It was designed to fire along the back of the first finger. A popular modification was to remove the firing elements from an LG-5 and mount them in other hand wear.
